bio.text: No more paughtraits whether refreshed or not. I abhor and abjure them and hope never to do another especially of the Upper Classes.

bio.text: [Sargent] was an American expatriate artist, considered the "leading portrait painter of his generation" for his evocations of Belle Époque and Edwardian-era luxury. He made roughly 900 oil paintings and more than 2,000 watercolors, as well as countless sketches and charcoal drawings.
It is as if painting were pure tact of vision, a simple manner of feeling.
